title: The Classification chip filters the list by classification
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, category Goodwill, in status Approved.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 3, for customer B, in status Approved, billable.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work orders list.
  2. Set the "Classification" chip to "Internal".
  3. Set the chip to "No Charge".
  4. Set the chip to "Billable".
  5. Set the chip to "All".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A chip "Classification: All" shows.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1 is listed; work order 2 and work order 3 are not.

Step 3:

  • Work order 2 is listed; work order 1 and work order 3 are not.

Step 4:

  • Work order 3 is listed; work order 1 and work order 2 are not.

Step 5:

  • All three work orders are listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R14: “While the Internal Work Orders setting is on, the work orders list shows a chip "Classification: All / Billable / Internal / No Charge" (the existing single-choice chip), default All, on every tab and in the mobile filter sheet. While the setting is off the chip is not shown; the badges on the rows stay.”
  • Terminology: “Classification → the three values a work order carries: Billable, Internal, No Charge. Written on the work order; the list filter and the export column use these words.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
